name: intlShippingSlowdown
notes: Latency injected directly into shipping. The cleanest self-time case in the demo: checkout and frontend both slow down waiting on it, so it is also the clearest test of the waiting-vs-cause distinction. Shipping is low volume — use a long window.

name: adManualGc
notes: Full manual GC in the ad service. Pauses show up as the ad service's own work, which is what self time is supposed to catch.

name: adHighCpu
notes: CPU saturation in the ad service.

name: cartFailure
notes: Error-rate case rather than latency: exercises the Failing verdict.

name: paymentFailure
notes: Payment sits at the end of the checkout funnel and produced 4 spans in a 30s window here. Either capture long enough to clear min-samples or drop this case — a decline caused by thin sampling is not a finding about the localizer.

name: productCatalogFailure
notes: Fails on one specific product, so the error rate moves less than the flag name suggests.

name: recommendationCacheFailure
notes: Cache failure degrades over time rather than stepping. A window captured too early may show nothing.
